definitions.gloss: picky eating; unbalanced diet; food preferences
definitions.explanation: Eating only certain types of food or avoiding specific foods, resulting in a nutritionally unbalanced diet.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{偏食|へんしょく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{悩|なや}んでいる→悩む：02380_nayamu⟧。
examples.english: I'm worried about my child's picky eating.

examples.japanese: {偏食|へんしょく}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{健康|けんこう}→健康：02706_kenkou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{良|よ}くない→良い：02350_yoi⟧。
examples.english: Picky eating is not good for your health.

examples.japanese: {偏食|へんしょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{直|なお}そう→直す：00869_naosu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{努力|どりょく}している→努力する：20201_doryokusuru⟧。
examples.english: I'm trying to fix my picky eating habits.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
⟦{偏|へん}→偏：26560_hen⟧ (biased, one-sided) + {食|しょく} (eating) - eating that is biased toward certain foods.

USAGE:
Describes:
- Children who refuse vegetables
- Adults with limited food preferences
- Nutritionally unbalanced diets

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {偏食|へんしょく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{激|はげ}しい→激しい：02348_hageshii⟧ - to be very picky
- {偏食|へんしょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{直|なお}す - to fix picky eating
- {偏食|へんしょく}⟦{傾向|けいこう}→傾向：02695_keikou⟧ - tendency toward picky eating

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{好|す}き{嫌|きら}い→好き嫌い：12206_sukikirai⟧ - likes and dislikes (food)
- ⟦{間食|かんしょく}→間食：07730_kanshoku⟧ - snacking
